invariants.description: the ion flux j_KM = -i_M/F (mol/s; the current in nA, so the factor 1e-9)
voltage step (V clamped at the run value, -30 mV, gate starting at rest V_rest_approx): w follows its exact clamp solution, tau = tau_w(V)/1000/phi
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(w - ((1/(1 + np.exp(-(V + V_mid_w + Delta_V_mid_w)/V_den_w))) + ((1/(1 + np.exp(-(V_rest_approx + V_mid_w + Delta_V_mid_w)/V_den_w))) - (1/(1 + np.exp(-(V + V_mid_w + Delta_V_mid_w)/V_den_w))))*np.exp(-t/((tau_w_min + tau_w_num/(2.0*np.exp((V + V_mid_w + Delta_V_mid_w)/15) + np.exp(-(V + V_mid_w + Delta_V_mid_w)/25)))/1000/(Q10_M**((T - T_ref_M)/10))))))) <= 1e-6

bc_sweep.rationale: Temperature: T is swept over 273.15-313.15 K (0-40 degC; the factors would give 148-590 K, where the Q10 factors are absurd); Q10s are bounded to 1-5 and T_ref to 273.15-313.15 K.

baseline.reason: a part of the SN_simple sympathetic neuron, whose values are the owner's hand-tuned SN_simple values; validation belongs to the assembled neuron (SN_soma / sympathetic_neuron supermodule).

calibrate.note: not_applicable here: g_M (rho_M) is calibrated in instance davis2020_wistar (Davis2020 Fig. 3C), and the default uses its calibrated rho_M; the other values are the owner's SN_simple values, validated in the assembled neuron.

calibrate.source: Davis et al. 2020, Hypertension 76:1915, Fig. 3C, measure defined in Davis 2021 thesis p. 172-173 (Wistar XE-991-sensitive M-current deactivation relaxation, 1 s step -25 -> -55 mV); Cm 30 pF assumed
